summary: Close four factual-disclosure gaps a fresh, independent integration review found: document that history is never rewritten/amended/rebased, so an intermediate integration commit that is not itself individually green is expected and the branch tip (not every ancestor) is the verified integration unit; document that the immutable Git-blob-bound archive mode and a genuine git-archive-extracted non-git tree are two distinct, never-interchangeable hash domains (currently, exactly 510 tracked .pal palette files carry a .gitattributes 'text eol=crlf' export/checkout transform, so their committed blob bytes (LF) and their extracted/checked-out bytes (CRLF) differ, and the two archive modes' hashes must never be compared as the same artifact); clarify that CANONICAL_DIR_MODE (0o755) is a defined-but-unused constant -- every written tar member (only ever a regular file; no directory members are ever added) is unconditionally 0o644, never 0o755, so 'modes 0644/0755' must never be read as describing the archive's own output; and correct texts/expansion's provenance note, which previously, inaccurately inherited the general 'texts' root's original-game-asset/Nintendo-copyright note by directory-prefix seeding even though texts/expansion is repository-authored issue #18 localization-framework catalog/source, never extracted or derived from the original game -- PROVENANCE_ROOT_SEED now seeds texts/textdefs.txt, texts/texts.txt, and texts/expansion as three disjoint, non-overlapping roots, and docs/release_data/provenance/assets.json is regenerated; author/rightsholder/license/redistribution-approval remain exactly as unresolved (NOASSERTION/false/null) as every other tracked path -- nothing is invented. Publication remains mechanically BLOCKED throughout.
